mapper.select: select A.app_seq , A.product_class , A.product_group_id , CASE WHEN LENGTH(A.full_ko) > 500 THEN LEFT(A.full_ko, 500) || '...' ELSE A.full_ko END AS product_summary_ko , CASE WHEN LENGTH(A.full_en) > 500 THEN LEFT(A.full_en, 500) || '...' ELSE A.full_en END AS product_summary_en , A.product_count from ( select app_seq , product_class , product_group_id , STRING_AGG(product_name_ko, ',' ORDER BY trim(product_name_ko) collate "C") AS full_ko , STRING_AGG(product_name_en, ',' ORDER BY trim(product_name_en) collate "C") AS full_en , product_count from utb_app_product where office_seq = #{officeSeq} and app_seq = #{appSeq} and del_yn = 'N' group by app_seq, product_class, product_group_id, product_count ) A

SELECT app_seq , product_seq , product_group_id , product_class , product_id , product_name_ko , product_name_en , nice_version , note FROM utb_app_product WHERE office_seq = #{officeSeq} AND app_seq = #{appSeq} AND product_group_id = #{productGroupId} AND del_yn = 'N'
